findings.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
findings.review_comment: Added path containment check prevents directory traversal by verifying that constructed paths remain within the intended filesystem boundary after canonicalization. This is a proper implementation of path traversal protection for file injection operations.
